title: Hash Map from Scratch
description: Build a chaining hash map in JavaScript, then measure probe lengths against theory as the load factor grows.

title: Heaps & Priority Queues
description: Implement a binary min-heap in Python, count its comparisons against the n·log n bound, and run a hospital triage queue on top of it.

title: Linked Lists in C
description: Pointer mechanics without the segfaults: an index-based linked list in C with insert, delete and an in-place reverse, drawn by a JS cell.

title: Stacks & Queues in Lua
description: A bracket matcher on a table-stack and a print-spooler ring buffer, all in offline Lua 5.4, with results handed to JavaScript.

title: Binary Search & the Shape of O(log n)
description: Instrument binary search in Python, race it against linear scan, then use "binary search the answer" on a problem with no array at all.

title: A* Pathfinding Playground
description: Generate a weighted terrain grid in JS, then steer a live A* search with sliders — watch Dijkstra, A* and greedy explore differently.

title: Mini Full-Text Search Engine
description: TF-IDF and cosine similarity over a tiny document collection in Python — type queries in a UI cell and watch ranked results update live.

title: Binary Search *on the Answer* (C)
description: No sorted array in sight: C binary-searches the answer itself to spread 4 routers as far apart as possible, and a JS cell charts the shrinking interval.

title: Composition Over Inheritance
description: Build the same little game world twice: a class tower that paints itself into a corner, then an entity-component design where new species are one line — rendered live in an HTML cell.

title: Design Patterns That Survive
description: Strategy, builder and observer as living code instead of UML — the strategy is swapped from a dropdown, the builder assembles queries, and the notebook bridge itself turns out to be an observer.

title: Game of Life, Compiled
description: C advances 40 generations of Life and ships every frame as packed hex; an HTML cell plays them back with a scrub bar. Three rules, endless behaviour.

title: Boids — Emergent Flocking
description: Three local rules, zero leaders: a live canvas flock whose cohesion, alignment and separation you tune with sliders while it flies.

title: SIR Epidemic Curves
description: The three-compartment model behind every pandemic chart you saw in 2020 — set R₀ and the infectious period with sliders, integrate with RK4, and find herd immunity where the maths says it is.

title: Forest Fire & Percolation
description: Lua burns forests at eight tree densities and finds the sharp threshold where fires suddenly cross the world — with a heat-map replay of the run at the critical density.

title: Double Pendulum & Chaos
description: Two double pendulums start a billionth of a radian apart; Python integrates both, matplotlib shows the exponential divergence, and an HTML cell animates them drifting out of sync.

title: Snake, Complete
description: A full playable Snake in one HTML cell — game loop, input, collision, scoring — that reports every run back to the notebook via nb.set.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe vs Minimax
description: Play X on an HTML board; Python is the unbeatable O — minimax with alpha-beta pruning, re-run per turn. The honest way to wire a human, a board and an engine together.

title: Sokoban + Solver
description: Push boxes onto goals with the arrow keys — then let a breadth-first search over (player, boxes) states find the optimal solution and replay it as ghost moves.

title: Breakout in p5.js
description: The 1976 classic in a p5 sketch — move with the mouse, and tune paddle width and ball speed from sliders while the ball is mid-flight.

title: Nim & Game Theory
description: C derives Grundy numbers with mex and brute-force-proves the XOR theorem; then you play Nim against the perfect strategy — and lose, unless you know the secret.

title: 3D Terrain from NumPy
description: Python generates a fractal island heightmap with NumPy; a three.js HTML cell turns it into an orbitable, height-coloured 3D landscape.

title: Parametric Surfaces
description: Lua evaluates (u,v) grids for a torus, a Möbius strip and a Klein bottle; three.js stitches them into meshes — including the one that famously has no inside.

title: Graph in Space
description: A JS cell runs a 3D force-directed layout on a clustered network; three.js renders it as orbiting spheres and edges you can spin.

title: Point-Cloud Sculptures
description: NumPy turns probability distributions into three sculptures — nested shells, a gyroid carved by rejection sampling, and a spiral galaxy — rendered as 12,000 glowing points.

title: Wave Equation on a Membrane
description: C finite-differences the 2D wave equation — a plucked drumhead with fixed edges — and three.js replays the ripples as a deforming mesh with a scrub bar.

title: Live Weather Dashboard
description: Fetch 48 h of real forecast data from the keyless Open-Meteo API in JS, crunch statistics in Python, and chart three cities side by side.

title: Where Is the ISS?
description: Poll the open-notify API for the space station's live position and watch its ground track crawl across a three.js globe — or a simulated orbit when offline.

title: Wikipedia Research Assistant
description: JS pulls two article extracts from the MediaWiki API (origin=* CORS), Python does the corpus linguistics — log-odds finds each topic's fingerprint words.

title: Driving Notebook Lab from Outside
description: Notebook Lab is itself an API: the window.NotebookLabAPI object and the file-based inbox let scripts and native programs build, run and save notebooks.

title: Local LLM in a Notebook
description: Talk to a model running on your own machine: LM Studio's OpenAI-compatible server, streamed token by token into a chat transcript — no cloud, no key, no telemetry.

title: Text, Numbers & Pickers
description: The starter controls — text, textarea, number, colour and date — and the one idea behind all of them: a control writes a typed value into nb, live. A JS cell prints each value and its type.

title: Sliders & Readouts
description: Sliders publish numbers; readouts render them. Shows precision/prefix/suffix formatting, a readout mirroring a slider live, and computed readouts fed by a JS cell (slider → JS → readout).

title: Choices: Select, Radio, Checkbox
description: The overhaul’s headline fix, demonstrated: a select or radio whose every option is numeric binds a real number, not "3". Shows the valueType override side by side, and booleans from checkboxes.

title: Buttons & Actions
description: The three button action modes as living counters and toggles — set, increment, toggle — a batch-writing reset button, and an honest note on why a plain button needs an action mode to re-fire.

title: Labels, Layout & the Designer
description: A tour of the authoring surface, not just runtime: the header band vs the label control, absolute x/y/width/height layout, and the designer tools — Tidy (grid-pack + grow-to-fit), Duplicate, and arrow-key nudging.

title: Shape Studio (live SVG)
description: Sliders for sides/radius/rotation and stroke width plus two colour pickers redraw a regular polygon live in an SVG cell — the canonical demonstration of controls driving a picture through nb.onChange.

title: Canvas Painter
description: A colour picker, a brush-size slider and a shape select drive a paint brush on an HTML <canvas>; a button clears the canvas via a timestamp write. Pointer events live inside the HTML cell — the controls only configure the brush.

title: CSS Theme Playground
description: Colour pickers and sliders bound to CSS custom properties style a live card — radius, shadow, font-size, hue. The HTML cell writes the generated CSS back into nb so a readout can export it live.

title: Round-trip: HTML → controls
description: The bridge runs both ways. Clickable swatches in an HTML cell call nb.set; a colour control, a readout and a JS cell all show the value that came back from the iframe — and editing the control highlights the matching swatch. Two-way, proven.

title: Graphing Calculator
description: The flagship: a preset select or a safe custom-expression evaluator (no eval) plus amplitude/frequency/phase and domain sliders; a canvas plots the curve and axes live while readouts report the roots and extrema in view.

title: Parametric & Polar Plotter
description: a/b/δ sliders draw Lissajous figures and rose curves on a canvas; a select swaps between the parametric and polar formulas live. A future xy-pad would replace two of the sliders — noted, not required.

title: Guess the Number
description: A complete game whose entire input surface is UI controls and whose logic is one JS cell: a number input and a Submit button, a seeded secret, hotter/colder feedback, and a tries readout. No HTML.

title: Colour Match
description: Three sliders (R/G/B) build your swatch; match a seeded target and a readout scores the distance; a button reseeds. Sliders and readouts under a goal, with the score computed in the HTML cell and written back to nb.

title: Reaction Timer
description: The wait/GO light and click target live inside the HTML cell — because the timing gesture must — and it writes the reaction time back to nb; UI readouts show last and best, and a reset button clears the run.

title: Mastermind (code-breaker)
description: Four numeric peg selects and a Guess button; a JS cell scores black/white pegs against a seeded secret code and accumulates the guess history in nb. Showcases numeric-enum selects and a discrete turn protocol.
